The '''GAT-12h "Skipray"''' was part of the [[GAT Blastboat series]] produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==Characteristics==
The GAT-12h "Skipray" was a twenty-five [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[GAT Blastboat series|Blastboat]].<ref name="ISB2" /> Equipped with a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] limited to four [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps,<ref name="ISB" /> the GAT-12h was capable of reaching speeds of 1,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="ISB2" /> The GAT-12h required a crew of four;<ref name="ISB" /> two crew and two [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]].<ref name="ISB2" />

The GAT-12h was armed with an impressive array of weaponry, including three medium [[Mendarn Arms]] [[Dar-2 ion cannon]]s, 2 [[Senko Systems]] [[5000x2 "Tru-Lok" laser cannon]]s mounted in a turret, a starboard [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]], and a port [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|skipray|Skipray blastboat}}</ref>

==History==
The GAT-12h "Skipray" was the most popular variant of the [[GAT Blastboat series]] produced by Sienar Fleet System in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ISB" />

The first GAT-12h Skipray Blastboats were released prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SotGSaga" /> Due to costs the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] didn't purchase all the vessels produced and Sienar eventually sold the blastboat to the private market, that way the Skipray was adquired by mercenaries and paramilitary groups.<ref name="DB" />
